== Hero Usage ==
*Heroes will attempt to maintain this skill at all times.

== Notes ==
* Used with [[Boon of Creation]] at rank 12, this skill can reduce the cost of binding rituals to 0 energy.
* While this skill has no casting time, it cannot be used while performing other actions or while knocked down.
* [[Distracting Shot]] is the only interrupt that disables Soul Twisting's effects.
** Interrupted rituals will not benefit from this skill's instant recharge effect ''and'' will be disabled by that attack.
** In contrast, those interrupted by [[Psychic Distraction]] ''will'' benefit from this skill's instant recharge effect, even though they will have been disabled briefly.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
